rv.q: It's reliably crowd-pleasing and family-friendly, with a string of familiar set pieces to delight those who come back year after year.
Sleeping Beauty at York Theatre Royal should go straight to the top of your festive bucket list.
The audience knows just what to expect and the show never disappoints.

cn.t: York's panto delights with silly surprises, strong performances, and crowd-pleasing humor. Critics praise the inventive additions, impressive ensemble work, and festive escapism that make it essential holiday viewing.
